format: html
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dashboardr::.page_config(accessibility = TRUE, crosstab_prefix = "social_characteristics")
```

```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| error: false
#| results: 'hide'

# Load dashboardr (includes dplyr, highcharter as dependencies)
library(dashboardr)

# Global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

# Load multiple datasets

# Load data_1
data_1 <- readRDS('data_1_19475obs.rds')
cat('data_1 loaded:', nrow(data_1), 'rows,', ncol(data_1), 'columns\n')

# Load data_2
data_2 <- readRDS('data_2_100obs.rds')
cat('data_2 loaded:', nrow(data_2), 'rows,', ncol(data_2), 'columns\n')

```


Social Characteristics

## Social Category  Distribution

```{r bar-social-category}
# Social Category  Distribution
result <- viz_bar(
  data = data_2,
  title = "Social Category  Distribution",
  x_var = "social_category",
  x_label = "Social Category",
  y_label = "Count"
)

result
```

## Village Distribution

```{r bar-village}
# Village Distribution
result <- viz_bar(
  data = data_2,
  title = "Village Distribution",
  x_var = "village",
  x_label = "Village",
  y_label = "Count"
)

result
```
